description: For every examples/*.exs (and fuzzy_search kernels.ex): measure compile time and agreement-check time without the benchmark (quiet machine; mark loaded runs provisional), and map which compiler areas its kernels exercise (e.g. floats/-ffp-contract, u64, bitstring accumulator, raise, multi-clause case, yields/resume, unzeroed alloc, 2-D indices, kernel-to-kernel inlining, hardware builtins like crc32c, elided bounds checks, value-semantics copies). Choose a small set of fast examples that together cover the areas; exclude every example whose expected verdict is :poor or :out_of_scope. Record the table and the choice (with reasons) in the ticket and in examples/README.md. No code change beyond measurement scripts in scratch.

comments.text:
Result (full table and area key: examples/README.md, section "Examples in mix test", commit 3fbc7d5 on branch defk-30c.1/example-subset).

Measured 2026-10-13, MIX_ENV=test, fresh _build/test/defk per example, host load 2.5-6 (12 cores): ALL NUMBERS PROVISIONAL (three passes agree within ~25%). Compile = kernel modules only, cold (C compile counts); check = 100 forced-yield assert_agrees draws per kernel with small-int/short-array generators (a floor: most draws raise early; the whole agreement_test.exs, 27 properties, takes 0.5 s).

Compile s (cold): _template 0.4, batched_levenshtein 0.54, byte_histogram 0.5-0.65, codecs 0.8-1.0, cosine_topk 0.4-0.7, fft 0.5-0.6, fuzzy kernels.ex 0.5, geo_nearest 0.45-0.57, geohash_crc 0.9-1.3 (two copies), gorilla_encode 0.4-0.5, hashes 1.3-1.4 (+0.5 portable copy), hll_update_many 0.3-0.45, image_blur 0.45-0.6, image_ops 0.5-0.8, lz4_snappy_decode 0.5-0.6, matmul 0.4-0.5, monte_carlo_rtp 0.5-0.6, pcm_mix 1.0-1.15, per_pair 0.4-0.6, rolling_stats 0.35-0.45, sort_u64_keys 0.35-0.45, utf8_valid 0.35-0.45, ws_masking 0.4-0.5, poor_* 0.4. Slow: blake 18, hash_chain 52 (26 x2), keccak 63, cdcl_sat 295 (cdcl_sat_per_call loads it), argon2 > 420 (never finished). out_of_scope: compile error by design.
Check cost: 0.01-0.3 s per example with bounded inputs; stock Defk.Properties generators never finish on image_blur, monte_carlo simulate, pcm mix, hash_chain, and take 1-8 s on codecs encode58, byte_histogram entropy, per_pair lev (need bounded generators).
Deps: no kernel module needs a Mix.install dep to compile; only Cosine.NxSearch (helper in cosine_topk.exs) fails without Nx. Catalog.load compiles every top-level defmodule without rescue, so it must skip that module; it also never sees argon2/blake/keccak (Module.create).

Mixed verdicts: argon2 (poor, marginal), cdcl_sat_per_call (good, poor), geohash_crc (one poor of five), hash_chain (poor, marginal), keccak (good, poor) are treated as excluded.

CHOSEN SET (cold compile ~4.8 s sequential in one VM, ~2.0 s with Task.async_stream across modules; today's six scripts 2.2 s / 0.9 s; warm cache 0.2 s; mix test now 83.5 s):
- geo_nearest (stays): floats/libm, top-k arrays
- rolling_stats (stays): sliding float sums, sqrt, hostile alloc sizes
- image_blur (stays): 2-D indices, unzeroed u8 arrays, bands
- gorilla_encode (new): only bitstring accumulator/return, only guarded multi-clause, clz/ctz, inlining
- lz4_snappy_decode (new): raise-heavy, copy/copy_back, word loads, early exit, kernel calls kernel
- hashes (new, 1.3-1.4 s, the dearest): hardware crc32c, u64 returns, wrap64, 159 inlined calls, attribute tables, macro-generated kernels
- hll_update_many (new, cheapest): [u64] input, clz, the one deliberate value-semantics copy
- cosine_topk (new): only f32 element type, tuple-of-arrays return (needs the kernel module loaded alone)
Plus fuzzy_search kernels.ex (yield: false twin; defk-30c.4).

Catalog today: geo_nearest, rolling_stats, image_blur stay; poor_list_data and poor_tiny_calls go (poor); _template goes (placeholder verdict, duplicates Examples.Kernels.sum). Tests that name the dropped modules and must change in defk-30c.2: test/elixir_mode_test.exs ("poor_list_data, poor_tiny_calls and the template": Orders, Example, Clamp) and test/value_semantics_test.exs ("the catalog's kernels have none"). Adding Hll.Kernels to that second test needs it to expect exactly one copy.

UNCOVERED: popcount/mulhi/rotl in real code (argon2, blake, hash_chain only; unit tests cover); narrow i16/i32 element types (pcm_mix, +1 s, first to add); 25-tuple accumulators and very large C (keccak 63 s, cdcl_sat 295 s: compile-time scaling untested); case-on-pattern bodies in Module.create generators (blake, argon2), max_owned/adaptive_slice options; bit-exact sin/cos beyond geo/rolling (fft); dense 2-D float loops (matmul). Benchmarks and Elixir baselines of the chosen examples are not run (they need the Mix.install deps).
